description: This Java class 'ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService' is responsible for validating external event configurations across tenants in the Fineract platform. It scans for event classes, checks configurations in the database, and ensures consistency for each tenant.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService
classes.description: Service class that validates external event configurations for all tenants, ensuring event class consistency and proper registration.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the service by validating event configurations for all tenants after properties are set.

methods.name: validateEventConfigurationForAllTenants
methods.description: Validates event configurations across all tenants, throwing exceptions if inconsistencies are found.

methods.name: validateEventConfigurationForIndividualTenant
methods.description: Validates event configuration for a specific tenant, comparing configured event types with expected event classes.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurationsForTenant
methods.description: Retrieves external event configuration types from the database for a given tenant.

methods.name: getAllEventClasses
methods.description: Scans classpath for event classes implementing the external event interface, excluding certain classes.
